cohort: 2932 women undergoing caesarean section at SDM College of Medical Sciences and Hospital, Dharwad, India from August 2020 to July 2021.
finding: The prevalence of congenital uterine anomalies (CUAs) was 0.75%, with the most common types being unicornuate uterus (31.8%), followed by septate (27.2%), arcuate (22.7%), and bicornuate uterus (18.1%).
